extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single-pass extraction. Tiled table: marks from both tiles unioned per row. Marks from pdftotext -bbox binned to header column centres, checked visually against renders of every page.

table_metadata.table_title: Table 2. Schedule of Activities for the Maintenance Treatment Period of Study J1P-MC-KFAH
table_metadata.table_purpose: Maintenance treatment period (V10-V29, Weeks 14-52) for participants who are responders at Week 12
table_metadata.notes: Typed track: the source restricts this schedule to responders at Week 12, a population mutually exclusive with Table 3 (nonresponders), even though both use visit numbers V10-V29. Horizontally tiled: pages 24-27 carry V10-V19 and pages 28-32 ('Table 2 (continued)') carry V20-V29 over largely the same body rows; rows unioned, marks merged. L=1; data columns positions 2-21; Comment column emitted as footnote annotations. Rows first printed only in the second tile: Review modified Mayo score (MMS), Diary return, Clinician-Administered Questionnaires (Paper), Physician's Global Assessment (PGA), Endoscopy, Colon biopsy sample collection.

annotations.annotation_text: This schedule applies to study participants who are responders at Week 12.
For procedures at an ETV, see ETV in Table 4.
For procedures at an early termination visit, see ETV in Table 4.
For procedures at an unscheduled visit, see V997 in Table 4.

Visits 10 through 28 are eligible to be conducted remotely (that is, by telephone, IT-assisted virtual visit, mobile healthcare, or a combination thereof), if written approval is provided by the sponsor and according to the preferences of the participant and the study site. However, no more than 34 days can elapse without an on-site study visit occurring.

Visits 10 through 28 are eligible to be conducted remotely (that is, by telephone, IT-assisted virtual visit, mobile healthcare, or a combination thereof) if written approval is provided by the sponsor and according to the preferences of the participant and the study site. However, no more than 34 days can elapse without an on-site study visit occurring.
For AESIs, additional data are collected (Section 8.3.6).

review_items.call_made: Table 2 is typed 'track' (track_label 'Responders') because its population statement restricts it to participants who are responders at Week 12, mutually exclusive with Table 3 (nonresponders).
review_items.alternative: Type it 'main_soa' as an independent maintenance-period schedule.

review_items.call_made: 'Table 2 (continued)' (pages 28-32, V20-V29) is treated as the second column tile of one horizontally tiled Table 2: rows are unioned by name and marks of both tiles merged into one 20-column table. Redacted 'CCI' rows are matched across tiles by their position between the same named neighbour rows.
review_items.alternative: Extract 'Table 2 (continued)' as a separate continuation table, or match the redacted rows differently (their identity cannot be confirmed from the text).

review_items.call_made: The title-cell remote-visit note is bound to the Visit number cells it names (tile 1: V10-V19 as t5; tile 2: V20-V28 as t6, V29 excluded because 'Visits 10 through 28'). The tile-2 wording differs only by a missing comma, and the ETV cross-reference is worded differently in tile 2, so the variants are kept as separate annotations.
review_items.alternative: Merge each pair of near-identical tile variants into one annotation and/or bind the remote-visit note to the whole Visit number row.

review_items.call_made: The comment 'Not applicable for responders during the time period of V10 through V19' printed on the 'Endoscopic Procedure' section-header row is bound to that header row (activity_name), so it governs the group; its child rows (Endoscopy, Colon biopsy) print only in the V20-V29 tile.
review_items.alternative: Bind the note to the Endoscopy and Colon biopsy sample collection rows, or to the V10-V19 columns.
